gitCommit.subject: Polish refinance and compare results, navigation and exit flows
gitCommit.body:
Polish refinance and compare results, navigation and exit flows

Fit four refinance offers in one row, badge only a genuine best offer, show
baseline cash flow beside the comparison, seed refinance from the calculator,
and give the refinance leave dialog the same save option as the other pages.
Results now enter with the calculator's staggered motion.
